name: Beef and broccoli stir-fry
summary: Thin strips of lean rump with crisp-tender broccoli, carrot and red pepper in a glossy garlic, ginger and soy sauce, served over brown rice.
about: Beef with broccoli is a Chinese-American takeaway dish that grew out of the Cantonese pairing of beef with Chinese broccoli. Cooked at home it needs only a little oil and sugar, and thin strips of rump cook in a couple of minutes.

ingredients.name: Broccoli
ingredients.note: one large head, cut into small florets

steps: Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil over high heat. Add the brown rice and boil, uncovered, for 25–30 minutes, until tender but still a little chewy. Drain well, return it to the pot and cover to keep warm.

Slice the steak across the grain into strips about 5 mm thick; 20 minutes in the freezer first makes this easier. Toss the strips with the 1 tbsp soy sauce and 2 tsp cornflour and leave for 10 minutes.
Stir the 2 tbsp soy sauce, the water, the 1 tbsp cornflour and the honey together in a jug until smooth.

Heat 2 tsp of the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until it shimmers. Add half the beef in one layer, leave it for 1 minute to brown, then stir-fry for 1 minute more, until browned outside but still a little pink inside. Tip onto a plate and repeat with another 2 tsp oil and the rest of the beef.

Add the last of the oil, the broccoli, carrot and 3 tbsp water. Cover and cook for 2 minutes, then uncover, add the red pepper, garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 2 minutes, until the broccoli is bright green and just tender and the water has gone.
Stir the sauce, pour it in and stir for about 1 minute, until it boils and turns thick and glossy. Return the beef and its juices and toss for 30 seconds, just to heat through, so it stays tender.
Scatter with the spring onions and serve over the brown rice.
prepNote: Slice the beef and vegetables and mix the sauce up to a day ahead; keep them covered in the fridge.
